# Original logo artwork (do not edit)

Untouched copies of the approved Hopewick logo references, kept for re-cropping later.

- `square-card.png` (1080×1080, RGB) and `wide-card.png` (1200×627, RGB): approved social cards
  that also define the homepage mobile and desktop layouts.
- `heart-horizontal.jpg` (634×211, RGB): simpler heart + sunrise + path mark beside the wordmark,
  on a photographic background (no transparency).

The highest-resolution transparent master already in the repo is `brand/source/hopewick-logo-source.png`
(1536×1024 RGBA), with `brand/hopewick-lockup.png` (1350×950 RGBA) and `brand/hopewick-mark.png`
(737×608 RGBA) built from it by `tools/brand/build_logo_assets.py`. All homepage logo sizes are resized
from those files. They are raster only; there is no vector (SVG) master.
